Description.name: Superno-Fa
Description.description: When the condensed stardust from the Big Clangor was fashioned into Keys, none could have predicted that they would one day be used to open Dipster doors among the Celestials themselves! It's unclear at this time how the Astral Dipsters come into being - are they parented to their own esoteric asterisms in the night sky? Also a mystery is how sound emanates from their seemingly quasarian mouths... and do they even have eyes? The Celestials seem unfazed by their new neighbors, and have welcomed them to join in the Celestial Island song!
